'''Palmerston County''' is one of the five counties in the [[Northern Territory]] of [[Australia]] which are part of the [[Lands administrative divisions of Australia]]. It contains the city of [[Darwin, Northern Territory|Darwin]]. It was proclaimed on 14 September 1871<ref name="SAGG-1871"/> and divided into [[Hundred (county subdivision)|hundreds]]. Being on the northern coast of the territory, it is bounded on the north and west by sea, the [[Adelaide River]] on the east and on the south by a line at longitude approximately 13°15' south (from a point adjacent to the southernmost of the [[Peron Islands]] to the township of [[Adelaide River, Northern Territory|Adelaide River]]).
